title: Refuse unreported empty-directory junctions inside pinned child checkouts
outcome: A junction inside an initialized pinned child is refused even when its target is empty and Git status reports no entry, under the existing capture budget and without changing ordinary-root admission.
acceptance: A Windows fixture establishes a real junction with an empty target and no Git-status entry, then requires source capture refusal at the child boundary; junction creation failures remain fatal.
The fix stays within the existing shared deadline and path bounds, retains initialized-child positive controls, and leaves no-gitlink ordinary capture admission and bytes unchanged.
